description: This file defines a reusable Flutter widget named DoctorCard, which displays information about a doctor using a Card layout. It shows the doctor's name, specialty, and bio, with customizable styling and an icon.

classes.name: DoctorCard
classes.description: A stateless widget that displays doctor information in a card format.

methods.description: Builds the widget tree for the DoctorCard, composing UI elements to display doctor info.
